import bpy,bmesh,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent;cap=root/'captures/shipyard_stone_20261115';craft=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
checks=[]
def ck(name,condition):
 assert condition,name
 checks.append(name)
ck('shape pass saved',craft.get('stone15_shape'))
ck('surface pass saved',craft.get('stone15_split_faces'))
ck('old boundary/coping archived',not any('workyard boundary' in o.name or o.name.startswith('Combined_front_A worn coping') for o in craft.objects))
ck('8 long slot coping stones',sum(o.name.startswith('S15 long slot coping') for o in craft.objects)==8)
ck('22 parapet components',sum(o.name.startswith('S15 parapet') for o in craft.objects)==22)
ck('49 leaves at authored shoulder',sum(o.get('stone15_plant',False) for o in craft.objects)==49)
ck('original side stair kept',sum(o.name.startswith('M14 shore stair') for o in craft.objects)==3)
ck('prior bank collision trim kept',bpy.data.objects['M14 continuous sculpted shore bank'].get('ground15_trimmed_buried_perimeter')==3573)
bad=[]
for o in craft.objects:
 if not (o.get('stone15') or o.get('stone15_split_face')):continue
 bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(o.data)
 count=sum(not e.is_manifold for e in bm.edges);bm.free()
 if count:bad.append([o.name,count])
ck('closed stone meshes',not bad)
source=cap/'before/shipyard_combined.glb'
# Record new and retained parts; gameplay/hull checks are performed in the main scene.

(cap/'source_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(stats,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
